details:
Ever since VRChat updated, it's been muuuuch slower when it comes to loading in worlds and avatars. There is also now a glitch where joining a pre-downloaded world, such as joining different instances of the same world, joining a world that's already downloaded because it's been previously visited, or when pressing the preload world button, the screen would no longer go straight to the joining world screen. Rather it would show the downloading world screen for around 5 seconds without progressing past zero, then show the loading world screen but it would take much longer to load. Same when joining a new world that hasn't been downloaded. The downloading would buffer and go slow every other second, then it would load in much slower than usual after. Another problem now is that upon joining a world a little bit larger or more than prison escape in storage size, a connection error would appear, preventing me from joining the world or any other worlds until I restart vrchat. But I know there aren't any connection issues because everything else on my Quest 3 (standalone) works just fine, and no changes regarding connection have been made. Only updating vrchat. Please fix this problem I feel like I can't play anymore. I've only seen this issue on my Quest 3 but have no idea if it's on other platforms as well since I haven't tried. 

I didn't see the Build Number option in the VRC settings. This is the newest VRChat update with the drone.
title: New update causing slowness and connection issues
